latestOwnerFeedback.interpretation: Owner authorized B2 closeout, GitHub preservation and research for an observable, intervenable world with human/AI character control.

decision.currentReleaseRenderer: SpriteKit on iOS/macOS and SwiftUI key poses or atlases on watchOS
rationale: The exported model, all nine logical parameter IDs and Cubism Core loading pass deterministic checks.
The Core motion probe returns exit 2 because none of the 12 tested parameter extremes changes drawable vertex hashes.
Cubism 5.4 Alpha External Application Integration does not expose ArtMesh vertex-coordinate editing, so MCP or GUI automation does not remove the real rigging bottleneck.
A custom canvas automation layer is not economical for one character and must not block the app.
decision.productDirection: A quiet small simulation world: observe, intervene, and take over a character; grounded actions and consequences.
decision.legacyAppStatus: preserved; physical acceptance and cross-device expansion deferred
decision.courtyardRenderer: Three.js 0.185.1 + three-vrm 3.5.5; independent fixed-camera browser prototype
decision.learningStatus: LLM action selection planned after deterministic world/control slice; no RL, fine-tuning or exploreBrain integration yet.
decision.authoringDirection: Blender remains the art source. B2 is archived; evaluate a separate real-time runtime without overwriting native art. Godot is the S1 recommendation, not yet installed or validated.
